name: Szarvaskő (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a blue stripe at the hoist edge and a green stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szarvaskő: a blue and brown shield with a stag and a castle, above a scroll inscribed SZARVASKŐ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
